issues.fact: Frozen v1 exact_balance_is_only_necessary_not_sufficient label is misleading. Exact finite-cycle balance is NEITHER necessary NOR sufficient for statistical stationarity.
issues.impact: Finite-count heuristic could be mistaken for a necessary stationarity condition.
issues.validation: Primitive finite-window count arithmetic; stochastic stationary systems can have nonzero sample balance, exact balance cannot establish stationarity.
issues.resolution: Candidate protocol explicitly rejects formal use of this frozen v1 helper label; review clarification appended while original output/code retained.
issues.remaining_scope: New formal stationarity method requires researcher-approved drift/uncertainty rules, no scientific rule selected here.

issues.fact: Frozen v1 source manifest includes a pre-freeze A+ supplement beyond the initial prepare command.
issues.impact: Reconstruction using initial prepare alone would omit two required summaries and fail closed.
issues.validation: Three independent synthetic preparation cases: complete step, frozen/duplicate refusal, source SHA failure.
issues.resolution: Added explicit tested supplement entry; documented two-step preparation. No original analysis/frozen source was modified or rerun.
